auditor: agent session (Claude), quality track reaudit mode, see run record
professional: an experienced CNC / fabrication job-shop estimator; they check first that machine-hour rate x cycle time and setup-once-per-lot are right at every quantity break, that starts cover expected fallout, that bar stock is bought in whole bars after kerf and remnant, that outside processing carries its lot minimum and its own markup, and that a missing input blocks the quote instead of being guessed

evidence.correctness: Three quotes (four breaks) worked by hand and compared to computeCost from ventures/jobshop-quote/apps/jobshop-quote/src/shared/costing.ts, bundled with the workspace's esbuild into a scratch probe (node probe.mjs): Q1 per-lb plate with 3% fallout (starts 104 for 100 good), Q2 per-foot bar with cut allowance and remnant (53 parts per 144 in bar, 1 bar at q50, 2 at q60) plus a setup-only programming operation, Q3 whole stock pieces with 5% fallout, outside passivate lot minimum, a certs lot extra and a line minimum. Every component, markup, unit price and total matches to the cent. Blank cycle time returns operation_needs_cycle_time; 0 setup and 0 cycle returns operation_has_no_time.
evidence.completeness: The app is now live on the free Early access plan (ROADMAP status: jobshop-quote.marisstella.app since 2026-11-27, deploys on every merge; not loadable from this session, the proxy refuses the host). Ran pnpm test:unit: 69 files, 783 tests pass; pnpm test:worker (API in workerd, incl. cross-tenant isolation): 53 files, 314 tests pass. Fallout, bar yield from bar length, rule reader and module pages are listed done and exercised by the probe or the suites. AI reading and inbound RFQ email are off and labelled off. Not run: test:e2e (browser).
evidence.verification: Five hand-seeded mutants in costing.ts through platform/ci/quality_mutate.py (private copy, unit suite): unit price Math.ceil -> Math.round (the 2026-11-26 survivor), startsFor returning quantity (fallout ignored), bar yield floor -> round, extras marked up at labor instead of material, per-part extras on starts instead of shipped quantity: all 5 CAUGHT.
evidence.craft: Read costing.ts (now 1,156 lines; the engine 336-615 and startsFor/barStockUse), quote-detail.tsx operation editor (lines 451, 705-770). Engine stays pure, integer cents, issues before arithmetic; cycle time is nullable and the new-operation default is null. Remaining: costing.ts still mixes the engine with ~500 lines of CAD suggestion helpers; client num('') -> 0 still applies to the Setup min box, so clearing it prices no setup with no issue (cycle has its own blank handling).
evidence.claims: platform/pages/industry-manufacturing.mjs: 'Reading RFQ emails and PDF drawings with AI is built but not switched on in the hosted app yet; until it is, you enter the parts yourself' (the prior overclaim is now qualified, backed by ROADMAP status). Free plan '40 RFQs a month, 3 users' matches plans.ts FREE_PLAN; llms.txt 'Shop $199/month, 125 RFQs; Shop Plus $399/month, 300 RFQs, not on sale yet' matches plans.ts priceCents 19_900 / 39_900 and rfqsPerMonth. 'Prices each part from your own shop rates' backed by computeCost. One stale record found: portfolio/flagships.yaml app: and next: still placed this app (and three other moved bets) in private-monorepo and listed deploy as open; fixed in this PR.
evidence.fitness: Walked a production quote: rate card, 100-piece lot at 3% fallout (prices 104 starts), bar job priced in whole bars from bar length, kerf and remnant, programming as a setup-only operation at the labor markup, outside processing lot minimum, line minimum. The result is the table an estimator would build by hand, and the app is now usable by a shop on the free plan. Gaps an estimator still hits: no dedicated per-lot labor line for FAI or inspection (setup-only operation or an extra at the material markup are the workarounds); AI reading of RFQs is off in the hosted app, so parts are entered by hand or by the rule reader.
evidence.domain: Against standard job-shop estimating practice the method holds: setup once per lot, starts = ceil(q / (1 - fallout)) for machine time and material, whole bars after cut allowance and remnant, outside processing with vendor lot minimums and its own markup, markup not confused with margin. One conservative choice a senior estimator might question: per-part finishing (outside or in-house) is priced on starts, though scrapped parts are often caught before finishing; it overprices slightly and the ROADMAP states it. Per-lb kerf and drop is still a weight percentage, acceptable for plate.

defects.what: portfolio/flagships.yaml gave jobshop-quote (and einvoice-preflight, seller-books, wall-framing-takeoff) `app: private-monorepo/apps/<slug>` a day after each moved into ventures/, and jobshop-quote's next: still listed deploy as open. portfolio/router/allocate.py turns that field into 'Work in private-monorepo/apps/<slug> (attach private-monorepo with add_repo ...)', so ventures runs on four paid bets were sent to the stale private copy.

Clearing the Setup min box sends 0 (num('') -> 0), so the operation prices with no setup and no issue; the cycle box got blank -> null handling in private PR #336, the setup box did not. A second operation on an already set-up machine legitimately has 0 setup, so the fix is a nullable setup like the cycle time, not a block on 0.
Prior defect 2, partial: no dedicated per-lot labor line for first-article or inspection; extras (the other workaround) are marked up at the material rate.

verdict: Meets the bar (correctness 3, claims 3, verification 3, median 3) and finished (completeness 3). Of the 2026-11-26 audit's seven defects, all counted fixed by the blanket fix_prs reading with none marked, six are closed and one is partial: blank and zero-time operations now block pricing, fallout prices the starts, bar yield comes from bar length, the rounding mutant is caught, and the page's AI claim is qualified. Three hand-worked quotes match the engine to the cent; 783 unit and 314 worker tests pass; 5 of 5 seeded mutants are caught. Fitness rises to 3 because the app is now live on the free plan. The worst defect found was outside the app: flagships.yaml still placed this and three other moved bets in private-monorepo, so the router sent runs to the stale copy; this PR fixes the field and adds a validate.py rule that fails on it. Left open: a cleared Setup box prices no setup, and there is no per-lot FAI/inspection labor line.
